paraphrase: Unacceptable: an app-store-like catalogue of third-party apps; inflating ad impressions or being mostly ads; collecting charity funds in-app unless an approved nonprofit; arbitrarily restricting users by location or carrier; manipulating rank on other services; binary options; unlicensed CFD or forex trading; loans above 36% APR, without full terms shown, or due in 60 days or less; and forcing people to rate, review or install other apps to use the app.
quote: Apps must not force users to rate the app, review the app, download other apps
